svg.title: The operator deploying and managing Dapr on Kubernetes
svg.desc: An operator figure stands above the cluster, named Operator and described as deploying and managing Dapr, with an arrow running down from it onto the cluster's border. A dashed region stands for the Kubernetes cluster. Along its top are the five Dapr control plane services, each in its own pod: placement, which maps actor instances to pods and is used for actors only; the sidecar injector, which injects the Dapr sidecar into annotated pods; sentry, the certificate authority, which manages mTLS and assigns SPIFFE identity; the operator, which manages components and Kubernetes service endpoints; and the scheduler, which schedules jobs for the Jobs and Workflow APIs. Each reaches down to an application pod in the middle, where the Dapr sidecar runs beside the application. The kubelet probes that pod, using readiness and liveness probes on the healthz API to decide Dapr health state. Below, a dashed strip headed "Host on any cloud or edge infrastructure" carries Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and Kubernetes. On the right, the sidecar uses components for publish and subscribe, workflows, state management, configuration and secrets.

g.text: Host on any cloud or edge infrastructure
